**What's the problem you're trying to solve?**
A brief description of what's frustrating or missing. (e.g. "I wish I could see my last few calculations without having to redo them.")

**What would you like to see?**
Describe the feature. Be as specific as you can — the clearer the ask, the easier it is to evaluate.

**Why does it belong in this app?**
This is a focused, minimal calculator. Help us understand why this feature fits within that.

**Any mockups or examples?**
If you have screenshots from other apps or a rough sketch, drop them here.

**Additional context**
Anything else worth mentioning.
